body:
CODE RED DECLARATION — one accountable Sherlock movie-to-recall vertical

Authority bead: bd-01M1CQ2H7VPSKRT02M5H7HN1K6, owned by codex-storymodel4s-chief. Terminal bead: bd-01M1CQSWJ538PAEME49200YARR. The epic cannot close until the terminal actual-pair court closes.

Outcome: one deterministic command takes the user-local two-part Sherlock edition plus an admitted recall export and emits a versioned machine-readable alignment and locally inspectable report. Raw video bytes remain external and are never copied into Git or outputs. The result retains edition playback coordinates, source and recall evidence, narrative and recall graphs, complete nomination provenance, GraphHsmm P and F, named external states, exact interval alternatives, missingness and trace receipts. Viterbi is a summary, never the uncertainty result.

Shortest staffed path:

0. LANDABILITY — owner/admin resolves stranded cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD. No current-main candidate authorization while ancestor_blocked remains.

1. IMMEDIATE EXECUTABLE GATE — existing provider contract plus reference-scope: bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG owned by codex-storymodel4s-collab and bd-01M1C5KCPBXA2NNC2KV89FW76F owned by scout. Current combined candidate c658733 is not canonical-reachable and has no usable evidence until the object is transferred without ref/index/worktree mutation and canonical evidence is refreshed. The no-model contract is not P1 completion.

2. REAL P1 — bd-01M1CQCSZSTHJQ5PA4PQ4GWKVB, queued to codex-storymodel4s-collab. Exact provider-parser subprocess, runtime manifest, WOG 50-sentence, held-out and real-transcript paths are frozen in the bead. It closes only on a pinned real local runtime and a compiler/downstream vertical. No downloads, terms, credentials or paid calls are authorized by this assignment.

3. B0 IN PARALLEL — policy candidate cand-6P2D7ZBV13BRD1XQ791PB3GCC5 at 63deb2a is under two exact reviews. Follow-on bd-01M1CQ5YS5M25F7HD9NN5YVAYP is queued to Sherlock intake for exact media, annotation, recall, alias, transform and timebase receipts on six docs/data paths. Non-video data are shareable under ordinary admission; no obsolete Sherlock rights or participant hold returns.

4. PORTABLE CONTRACT — bd-01M1CQEWA4GWY5NW0QAGWYP31H, queued to recall-collab after P1/B0. Exact seven core/laws paths. Cross-platform SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, EvidenceSupport and NarrativeSourceAtlas; no decoder/provider/JVM API.

5. FIRST INTEGRATION, PARALLEL AFTER C1 — D0 bd-01M1CQH3QNRMHZYR593DQWEBY7 to Sherlock intake under acquire JVM-specific sources; D1A bd-01M1CQKRG1A4J4BEWCC78F4TEZ to storymodel4s-collab for acquire/document/story migration. D0 never reads video; it preserves 1000/50/30 populations and diagnostic authority.

6. ALIGNMENT — bd-01M1CQNM5DZZNWD8BN4WRKVZRQ to recall-collab after D0/D1A plus the frozen nomination and visualization courts. Exact align/laws paths retain full P/F, axis identity, intervals, complete nomination ledger, support, external states and recursively checked traces.

7. WIRE/VIEW — bd-01M1CQQDCWN2RTT1Z8XNNB7VMY to storymodel4s-collab after D1B and the current output-authority repair. Exact codec/view paths, versioned lossless round-trip and renderer-neutral one-unit focus packets.

8. TERMINAL ACTUAL PAIR — bd-01M1CQSWJ538PAEME49200YARR remains chief-accountable. Exact fixtures JVM, shell runner, result and static report paths. Completion requires the admitted actual Sherlock pair, byte-identical rerun, independent numerical oracle, mutation suite, accessible DOM and screenshot review; a synthetic fixture alone cannot close it.

SUBORDINATION. Output authority repair and the current P/F, nomination-provenance and pre-data calibration courts may finish their current immutable handoffs because they are direct prerequisites. No calibration implementation, generalized exporter, docs styling, gray-band preview work or unrelated audit may claim priority or product progress ahead of this chain. The gray preview remains a mechanical regression artifact, not a milestone.

This is an execution plan, not a completion claim. Today the repository still lacks the real provider runtime, portable film contract, Sherlock adapter, cross-module movie support and actual-pair command.
